summary: the textbusy suite's bind-holder probe on x86-64 with the boot root's bind holders compared without their base mount

argv: make -s rach2 tests krffs musl-programs test-image build/tests/system/harness ARCH=x86_64 </dev/null && cp build/x86_64/rach2/kernel ${WORK}/kernel
log=build/x86_64/images/textbusy-test.log; rm -f $log; status=0; make -s run-textbusy ARCH=x86_64 </dev/null || status=$?; [ ! -f $log ] || cat $log; exit $status

faults.name: descriptor
faults.summary: a descriptor on a bind of the boot root not counted as a holder of the root

faults.name: image
faults.summary: a running image from a bind of the boot root not counted as a holder of the root, with the root's segments copied so that the image is the only holder
